data.long_meaning: The name Bathsheeb is derived from the Hebrew words 'bat' (daughter) and 'sheba' (seven). In the Old Testament, Bathsheeb is the name of a beautiful woman who was the wife of King David. The story of Bathsheeb is found in 2 Samuel 11. The name Bathsheeb carries the meaning “Daughter of the Bath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Bathsheeb usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the bath and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Her story is a powerful reminder of the importance of maintaining our spiritual connection with God, and seeking his guidance in all aspects of life.
